# Konza Prairie Community Health Center

> > Federally Qualified Health Center serving Junction City, Manhattan, and Chapman, Kansas with integrated medical, dental, behavioral health, pharmacy, and WIC services.

Konza Prairie Community Health Center (KPCHC) is a nonprofit FQHC providing comprehensive healthcare to underserved communities in Kansas. The center operates walk-in clinics, 340B pharmacy services, Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT) programs, and community support initiatives including the Konza Cupboard food pantry.

## Key Topics

- Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC)
- Junction City clinic location
- Manhattan clinic location
- Chapman clinic location
- 340B Drug Program pharmacy
- Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Konza WIC program
- Diabetes management and prevention
- Sexual health and STI testing
- PrEP (Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis)
- Konza Cupboard food pantry
- Integrated care model
- Medicaid and Medicare acceptance
- Community health education
- Breastfeeding support services

## Core Services & Information

- [Who We Are](https://kpchc.org/who-we-are): FQHC nonprofit health center history and integrated care mission
- [Meet Our Care Team](https://kpchc.org/meet-our-care-team): Healthcare provider directory including medical, dental, and behavioral staff
- [Contact](https://kpchc.org/contact): Contact info for Junction City, Chapman, and Manhattan clinic locations
- [Walk-In Clinic](https://kpchc.org/services/walk-in-clinic): No-appointment urgent care in Junction City with on-site lab and pharmacy
- [Pharmacy](https://kpchc.org/services/pharmacy): 340B Drug Program pharmacy services across three Kansas locations

## Specialized Treatment Programs

- [Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT)](https://kpchc.org/services/medication-assisted-treatment-mat): MAT program for opioid and alcohol addiction using naltrexone and suboxone
- [WIC](https://kpchc.org/services/wic): WIC nutrition assistance program for women, infants, and children
- [WIC Breastfeeding](https://kpchc.org/services/wic-breastfeeding): Konza WIC lactation support, breast pump rental, and breastfeeding education

## Health Education & Awareness

- [Sexual Health Awareness: Are You Feeling It?](https://kpchc.org/news/sexual-health-awareness-are-you-feeling-it): Sexual Health Awareness Week coverage on STI testing, PrEP, and safe sex
- [Take Charge of Tomorrow: Prevent Diabetes Health Problems](https://kpchc.org/news/take-charge-of-tomorrow-prevent-diabetes-health-problems): National Diabetes Month article on prevention and management strategies
- [Are You Living With Diabetes? Take Charge Today](https://kpchc.org/news/living-with-diabetes-take-charge-today): Diabetes management guide with nutrition tips and Diabetes Food Hub resource
- [Oral Cancer Awareness Month](https://kpchc.org/news/oral-cancer-awareness-month): Oral Cancer Awareness Month info on HPV prevention and cancer screening
- [Free HIV Self-Tests by Mail](https://kpchc.org/news/free-hiv-self-tests-by-mail): Together TakeMeHome program offering free mail-order HIV self-tests
- [Tips for a Happy and Healthy Summer](https://kpchc.org/news/tips-for-a-happy-and-healthy-summer): Summer health tips covering sun safety, water safety, and injury prevention

## Community Events & Support

- [Food Drive to Stock the Konza Cupboard - 2024](https://kpchc.org/news/food-drive-to-stock-the-konza-cupboard-2024): Community Care Clinic Month food drive for Konza Cupboard pantry
- [Konza Cares Food Drive - August 2025](https://kpchc.org/news/konza-food-drive-august2025): August 2025 Konza Cares food drive for Konza Cupboard food pantry
- [Family Fun-n-Fit Day 2026](https://kpchc.org/news/family-fun-n-fit-day-2026): Free family fitness event at Playground Park with community partners
- [Halloween Costumes for Kids](https://kpchc.org/news/halloween-costumes-for-kids-2025): Halloween costume swap event at Junction City location and library
